# Chapter 1 — Radio/monotone polarity (long speech vs short-flat card)

Radio Fixture keyed the mic.

Radio Fixture said, "I would prefer that we reconsider the entire arrangement before dawn arrives over the eastern wall."

Radio Fixture said, "There is simply no acceptable path that leaves the outer gate unguarded while the council debates protocol."

Radio Fixture said, "Every messenger we send across the bridge becomes another liability we cannot afford to bury quietly."

Radio Fixture said, "If the ledger is wrong then the entire season of oaths collapses into ash and unpaid debts."

Radio Fixture said, "Stand aside and let the watch rotate before the next bell marks another failed promise."
